title: Minimum Time to Finish the Race
summary: Given a 2D array tires where each element [fi, ri] represents the time to complete the x-th lap for the i-th tire, and integers changeTime and numLaps, determine the minimum time to complete numLaps laps.
statement: Given a 2D array tires where each element [fi, ri] represents the time to complete the x-th lap for the i-th tire, and integers changeTime and numLaps, determine the minimum time to complete numLaps laps. You can start with any tire and change to any tire after waiting changeTime seconds between laps.
constraints: A tire [first,ratio] takes first*ratio^(x-1) seconds on its x-th consecutive lap.
Changing before a lap costs change_time; choosing the initial tire is free.
Return the minimum time for exactly num_laps laps, and a change may select any tire including the same type.
hints: Long consecutive tire runs become worse than changing once their next lap exceeds a fresh first lap plus change cost.
Precompute the best same-tire time for each useful stint length, then partition the race into stints.
Set dp[0]=-change_time; append a stint with one change plus its precomputed time; minimize over stint lengths.
Every race strategy is a partition into consecutive same-tire stints, and each stint uses its best tire; the negative initial change cancels the charge before the first stint.
editorial: Every race strategy is a partition into consecutive same-tire stints, and each stint uses its best tire; the negative initial change cancels the charge before the first stint.

tests.explanation: Combining short tire stints with one change completes four laps in 21 seconds.
The best sequence of tire stints completes five laps in 25 seconds.
